title: Horizontal and Vertical Defect Management with a Novel Degradable Pure Magnesium Guided Bone Regeneration (GBR) Membrane-A Clinical
authors: Case Frosecchi, Massimo. Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania) vol. 59,11 2009. 15 Nov. 2023, doi:10.3390/medicina59112009
supports: Clinical study from the botiss NOVAMag (magnesium membrane, screw, SHIELD) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “In this case, the magnesium membrane in combination with a collagen pericardium membrane presented a potentially viable alternative treatment to titanium meshes or Relevant Publications - NOVAMag® membrane and NOVAMag® fixation screw titanium-reinforced membranes for the augmentation of a defect with both horizontal and vertical components that is completely resorbable. It was demonstrated that it is possible to attain a good quality and quantity of bone using a resorbable system that has been completely resorbed by the time of reentry” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
